title: Agent Skill frontmatter accepted by claude.ai and the Skills API
description: YAML frontmatter of a SKILL.md uploaded to claude.ai or through the Skills API. Only the six Agent Skills spec fields are accepted; any other key is rejected with an unexpected-key error. Put client-specific values under `metadata`.

name.description: Skill name. At most 64 characters, lowercase letters, digits and hyphens only.

description.description: What the skill does and when Claude should use it. Non-empty, at most 1024 characters.

license.description: License covering the skill, such as a license name or the name of a bundled license file.

compatibility.description: Environment requirements such as the intended product or system prerequisites. At most 500 characters.

metadata.description: Free-form map for client-specific properties the Agent Skills spec does not define.

allowed-tools.description: Tools pre-approved to run while the skill is active. Experimental: support varies between products.

stringOrStringList.title: string or list of strings
stringOrStringList.description: A single string, or a YAML list of strings.
